name: diag-log
summary: DIAGNOSTIC: RAM event log (ms time stamps) of panel on/off callers, OSD timer expiry, the standby gate and start-up milestones; read with diag-poke + tools/logread.py

edits.asm: diag-log hook stubs (linker padding 0x203A9C)
diag-log 1 ms ISR stub (linker padding 0x203CE0)
diag-log log routine (linker padding 0x203B08); data at 0x203968-0x2039EF
diag-log start-up milestone stubs (linker padding 0x203BA3)
diag-log start-up call checkpoints (linker padding 0x2038AA)
b.addi -> j isr (1 ms ISR entry: ms counter)
b.addi -> j h_off (sub_245860 entry (panel off))
b.sw -> j h_on (sub_245919+5 (panel on))
b.addi -> j h_sig (sub_258AB1 entry (re-enter No signal))
b.addi -> j h_st4 (sub_26A7C5 entry (OSD state 4 entry))
b.jal -> j h_gate (jal standby_gate_query in the power-save entry)
b.ori -> j m_init (sub_261FDE after the prologue (main init start))
b.jal -> j m_dev (jal sub_23FF28 after sub_23D3EB (init done))
b.movhi -> j m_loop (movhi r10,0x45 before the main loop)
b.ori -> j m_bl (sub_245919 backlight-on step)
b.jal -> j c_26f272 (jal sub_26F272: time stamp after it returns)
b.jal -> j c_255568 (jal sub_255568: time stamp after it returns)
b.jal -> j c_261fa8 (jal sub_261FA8: time stamp after it returns)
b.jal -> j c_2411a5 (jal sub_2411A5: time stamp after it returns)
b.jal -> j c_20dc56 (jal sub_20DC56: time stamp after it returns)
b.jal -> j c_238350 (jal sub_238350: time stamp after it returns)
b.jal -> j c_25fd58 (jal sub_25FD58: time stamp after it returns)
b.jal -> j c_23d51c (jal sub_23D51C: time stamp after it returns)

notes: Log at 0x203968 (ms counter), 0x20396C (event count), 0x203970 (16 x 8-byte ring: ms, tag<<24 | value). tools/logread.py maps the tags (see 'tags') to F (panel off), N (panel on), S (OSD timer expiry), E (state 4 entry), G (gate result), I (main init start), D (init done), M (main loop start), B (backlight on), C (after a start-up call, c_<callee>). The log is in RAM and starts empty at every firmware start. Generated by tools/patches_src_diag_log.py.
